Introduction

Han Seung Woo is a South Korean singer currently under Aura Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group VICTON and a former member of the project boy group X1. Han Seung Woo debuted as a member of VICTON on November 9, 2016, with the mini album Voice To New World.

In 2019, he, along with fellow VICTON member Choi Byung Chan, participated in Mnet's boy group survival show Produce X 101 representing Play M Entertainment. Seung Woo finished in third place, earning a position in the project group X1. The group officially debuted on August 27, 2019, with the mini album 비상 : Quantum Leap. On January 6, 2020, the agencies representing X1 members announced the group’s disbandment following the Produce 101 vote manipulation controversy, as they were unable to reach a unanimous agreement. On January 29, it was announced that Seung Woo would resume activities with VICTON.

Seung Woo released his first solo mini album, Fame, on August 10, 2020. He enlisted in the military on July 26, 2021, and was discharged in January 2023. During his service, his contract period was adjusted, allowing him to remain with IST Entertainment after VICTON’s contract expiration. On November 28, 2024, Han Seung Woo announced his departure from IST Entertainment. He subsequently signed an exclusive contract with Aura Entertainment on December 13, 2024.
